notes.title: v1.4.0
notes.content:
- New item: Eternus

- Daedalus: Effect changed from "Every 2 seconds you are alive, gain 1 Attack permanently." to "On hit, gain 12 Attack until death."

- Fortis: Minion Defense gain per level increased from 2 to 3
- Fortis: King Defense gain per level increased from 4 to 5

- Bracer: Defense increased from 6 to 7
- Vambrace: Defense increased from 12 to 14
- Manica: Defense increased from 24 to 28

- Gauntlet: Defense increased from 10 to 11
- Iron Gauntlet: Defense increased from 20 to 22
- Titan: Defense increased from 40 to 44

- Hide: Defense increased from 15 to 17
- Hide: Movespeed decreased from -0.14 to -0.15
- Chestplate: Defense increased from 30 to 34
- Chestplate: Movespeed decreased from -0.28 to -0.3
- Nemean Hide: Defense increased from 60 to 68
- Nemean Hide: Movespeed decreased from -0.56 to -0.6

- Bracelet: Price decreased from 87 to 83
- Armlet: Price decreased from 216 to 205
- Brachium: Price decreased from 594 to 560

- Soul Shield: Price increased from 500 to 600

- Soul Ring: Price increased from 500 to 600
- Soul Ring: HP gained increased from 25 to 65

- Mortal Helm: Fixed description showing 0.5 instead of 0.6

- Slightly decreased difficulty of campaign level 0
- Increased difficulty of all campaign levels after level 22
- Reworked difficulty of all campaign levels after level 0

- Fixed an item tooltip bug

- Changed Blood Blade artwork
- Slightly changed Daedalus artwork

- Leaderboard players shown increased from top 10 to top 100

- Fixed text wrapping for stat gain items in the inventory

- Slightly decreased height of shop timer bar
